id: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969)

facts.text: I've got a plan for dessert, Sundance. You won't like it, but it involves Bolivia.
facts.why: Butch never says this. His real Bolivia line is on the quote page. It is printed in quote marks as his words.
facts.fix: Kid, next time I say 'Let's go someplace like Bolivia,' let's go someplace like Bolivia.

facts.text: The gang's new life in Bolivia
facts.why: In the film only Butch, Sundance and Etta head to Bolivia; the rest of the gang stays at Hole-in-the-Wall.
facts.fix: Butch and Sundance's new life in Bolivia

vibe.verdict: The hideout and the dynamite pretzels suit it, but it leaves out the best known lines and scenes.
missing: 'Who are those guys?' about the posse (the chase)
'Raindrops Keep Fallin' on My Head' on the bicycle
Harvey Logan's knife fight, 'Rules? In a knife fight?' (the hideout)
Spanish phrases written on a card for the Bolivian bank (the robbery)
The cliff jump, 'The fall will probably kill ya'
ideas: Swap the 'Pisco punch' note for 'Who are those guys? Drink up, ride on.' as a real quote nod with quote marks.
Swap 'Bicycle ride lemon cake' for 'Raindrop lemon cake' with a note on the song.
Swap 'Hole-in-the-Wall chilli' note for 'No rules at this table.'
Swap 'Table for two, quietly' on the slip for 'Table for three, Etta rides along'.
